253: // signals, so the SQL scores are advisory.
254: const rollupCredentialModelIndexSQL = `
255: -- ── Half 1: traffic-derived rows (5-min window from request_logs) ─────────
256: SELECT
257:     $1::timestamptz AS bucket,
258:     rl.credential_id,
259:     COALESCE(rl.outbound_model, rl.client_model) AS raw_model,
260:     mo.canonical_id,
261:     mo.billing_mode,
262:     AVG(mo.unit_price_in_per_1m)  AS unit_price_in_per_1m,
263:     AVG(mo.unit_price_out_per_1m) AS unit_price_out_per_1m,
264:     MAX(mc.context_window)        AS context_window,
265:     -- success rate over the bucket window
266:     COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN rl.success THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 0.9) AS success_rate,
267:     COALESCE(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY rl.latency_ms)::int, 1000) AS p95_latency_ms,
268:     -- active_sessions / concurrency_limit / pressure_ratio:
269:     --   advisory fields, set to 0 here (no subquery).
270:     --   The customer_cost_view recomputes active_concurrent live from
271:     --   request_logs so this static value is informational only.
272:     0                          AS active_sessions,
273:     MAX(cr.concurrency_limit)  AS concurrency_limit,
274:     0::numeric                 AS pressure_ratio,
275:     -- Simplified pre-computed scores (no subquery; pressure assumed 0).
276:     -- smart weights: price=25 speed=25 stab=20 match=25 pressure=10 ctx=15
277:     (COALESCE(100 * (1 - LEAST(1.0, AVG(mo.unit_price_in_per_1m + mo.unit_price_out_per_1m) / 20.0)), 50) * 0.25
278:    + COALESCE(100 - LEAST(100, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY rl.latency_ms) / 30), 50) * 0.25
279:    + COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN rl.success THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 0.9) * 100 * 0.20
280:    + 50 * 0.25
281:    + 100 * 0.10
282:    + 80 * 0.15)::numeric(8,4) AS score_smart,
283:     -- speed_first weights: price=10 speed=50 stab=20 match=15 pressure=5 ctx=10
284:     (COALESCE(100 * (1 - LEAST(1.0, AVG(mo.unit_price_in_per_1m + mo.unit_price_out_per_1m) / 20.0)), 50) * 0.10
285:    + COALESCE(100 - LEAST(100, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY rl.latency_ms) / 30), 50) * 0.50
286:    + COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN rl.success THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 0.9) * 100 * 0.20
287:    + 50 * 0.15
288:    + 100 * 0.05
289:    + 80 * 0.10)::numeric(8,4) AS score_speed_first,
290:     -- cost_first weights: price=50 speed=10 stab=15 match=20 pressure=5 ctx=10
291:     (COALESCE(100 * (1 - LEAST(1.0, AVG(mo.unit_price_in_per_1m + mo.unit_price_out_per_1m) / 20.0)), 50) * 0.50
292:    + COALESCE(100 - LEAST(100, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY rl.latency_ms) / 30), 50) * 0.10
293:    + COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN rl.success THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 0.9) * 100 * 0.15
294:    + 50 * 0.20
295:    + 100 * 0.05
296:    + 80 * 0.10)::numeric(8,4) AS score_cost_first
297: FROM request_logs rl
298: JOIN credentials cr ON cr.id = rl.credential_id
299: LEFT JOIN model_offers mo
300:   ON mo.credential_id = rl.credential_id
301:  AND (mo.outbound_model_name = COALESCE(rl.outbound_model, rl.client_model)
302:    OR mo.raw_model_name = COALESCE(rl.outbound_model, rl.client_model))
303: LEFT JOIN models_canonical mc ON mc.id = mo.canonical_id
304: WHERE rl.ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
305:   AND rl.ts < NOW()
306:   AND rl.credential_id IS NOT NULL
307:   AND COALESCE(cr.status, 'active') NOT IN ('disabled')
308:   AND COALESCE(cr.lifecycle_status, 'active') != 'suspended'
309: GROUP BY rl.credential_id, COALESCE(rl.outbound_model, rl.client_model),
310:          mo.canonical_id, mo.billing_mode
311: 
312: UNION ALL
313: 
314: -- ── Half 2: cold-start fallback (added 2026-06-28, provider-314 incident) ─
315: -- For every routable binding that the request_logs rollup above did NOT
316: -- already produce, write a baseline row so the auto-route can see it
317: -- even with zero recent traffic. Baseline values are intentionally
318: -- conservative (success=0.9, p95=1000, scores=50) — the first real
319: -- request through the credential will produce a request_logs row that
320: -- the half-1 rollup will overwrite via ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE below.
321: --
322: -- Anti-join clause: skip pairs that already appeared in half 1 so we
323: -- don't churn the ON CONFLICT path. Note we deliberately do NOT
324: -- re-derive rl.ts in the anti-join's filter — half 1 itself filters on
325: -- the same 5-min window, so equality is sufficient.
326: SELECT
327:     $1::timestamptz                     AS bucket,
328:     v.credential_id,
329:     pm.raw_model_name                   AS raw_model,
330:     pm.canonical_id,
331:     cmb.billing_mode,
332:     cmb.unit_price_in_per_1m,
333:     cmb.unit_price_out_per_1m,
334:     mc.context_window,
335:     0.9::numeric(5,4)                   AS success_rate,
336:     1000::int                           AS p95_latency_ms,
337:     0::int                              AS active_sessions,
338:     c.concurrency_limit,
339:     0::numeric(5,4)                     AS pressure_ratio,
340:     50::numeric(8,4)                    AS score_smart,
341:     50::numeric(8,4)                    AS score_speed_first,
342:     50::numeric(8,4)                    AS score_cost_first
343: FROM v_routable_credential_models v
344: JOIN credentials c                  ON c.id = v.credential_id
345: JOIN credential_model_bindings cmb ON cmb.id = v.binding_id
346: JOIN provider_models pm             ON pm.id = v.provider_model_id
347: LEFT JOIN models_canonical mc       ON mc.id = pm.canonical_id
348: WHERE v.is_routable = TRUE
349:   AND pm.raw_model_name IS NOT NULL
350:   AND NOT EXISTS (
351:       SELECT 1 FROM request_logs rl
352:       WHERE rl.credential_id = v.credential_id
353:         AND (rl.outbound_model = pm.raw_model_name
354:           OR rl.client_model  = pm.raw_model_name)
355:         AND rl.ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
356:   )
357: `
